# Tools

## functions

namespace functions {

// Read a file. Returns its lines, numbered, and its version.
type read = (_: {
// Path of the file, relative to the workspace root.
path: string,
// At most this many lines.
limit?: number,
}) => any;

// Create a file, or replace one whole. Give the complete new content.
type write = (_: {
// Path of the file.
path: string,
// The complete new content of the file.
content: string,
}) => any;

} // namespace functions<|end|><|start|>user<|message|>Copy a.txt to b.txt.<|end|><|start|>assistant<|channel|>analysis<|message|>MARK-ALPHA I should read a.txt first, to know what to copy.<|end|><|start|>assistant<|channel|>commentary to=functions.read <|constrain|>json<|message|>{"path": "a.txt"}<|call|><|start|>functions.read to=assistant<|channel|>commentary<|message|>=== a.txt (1 line, version 11111111) ===
1	hello<|end|><|start|>assistant<|channel|>analysis<|message|>MARK-BETA The file says hello, so b.txt gets the same line.<|end|><|start|>assistant<|channel|>commentary to=functions.write <|constrain|>json<|message|>{"path": "b.txt", "content": "hello\n"}<|call|><|start|>functions.write to=assistant<|channel|>commentary<|message|>wrote b.txt (1 line)<|end|><|start|>assistant
